SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN oe.IS_WON THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oe.OPPORTUNITY_ID) AS win_rate_vs_splunk
FROM OFFICE_DW.SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED oe
JOIN OFFICE_DW.SFDC.OPPORTUNITY o
  ON oe.OPPORTUNITY_ID = o.ID
WHERE oe.IS_CLOSED = TRUE
  AND LOWER(o.COMPETITOR_C) LIKE '%splunk%';
